<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

           <h1>Meshery v0.8.198</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.8.198">Released</a> on January 16, 2026</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>Bump axios from 1.8.2 to 1.12.0 in /install/docker-extension/ui @[dependabot[bot]](https://github.com/apps/dependabot) (#15816)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="️-meshery-cli">⌨️ Meshery CLI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[mehseryctl] Get rid of golden files in design command and add new unit tests @shri771 (#16842)</li>
  <li>feat: add GetConnectionByID endpoint and update connection status constants @leecalcote (#16948)</li>
  <li>[WIP] Fix issues in GetConnectionByID endpoint and helper function usage @[copilot-swe-agent[bot]](https://github.com/apps/copilot-swe-agent) (#16950)</li>
  <li>Replace fmt.Errorf with meshkit error handlers in connections view command @[copilot-swe-agent[bot]](https://github.com/apps/copilot-swe-agent) (#16949)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] Update system context outdated golden files  @shri771 (#16940)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>UI: Added missing @next/swc optional dependency entries @yi-nuo426 (#16990)</li>
  <li>[Chore]: Update to Sistent v0.16.4 @l5io (#16978)</li>
  <li>Fix: Update the FullscreenLoader to be consistent between prereact and postreact renders @aabidsofi19 (#16957)</li>
  <li>[Chore]: Update to Sistent v0.15.24 @l5io (#16970)</li>
  <li>[UI] Enhance MeshSync event metadata formatting in Notification Center @[copilot-swe-agent[bot]](https://github.com/apps/copilot-swe-agent) (#16944)</li>
  <li>Fix ESLint errors in e2e test files @[copilot-swe-agent[bot]](https://github.com/apps/copilot-swe-agent) (#16947)</li>
  <li>Add hover effect to Resource List links in Help Center and Latest Blog widget @Rajesh-Nagarajan-11 (#16939)</li>
  <li>[Chore]: Update to Sistent v0.15.23 @l5io (#16941)</li>
  <li>fix broken tests @aabidsofi19 (#16936)</li>
  <li>[Chore]: Update to Sistent v0.15.22 @l5io (#16935)</li>
  <li>[Chore]: Update to Sistent v0.15.21 @l5io (#16909)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[Chore]: Update to Sistent v0.16.4 @l5io (#16978)</li>
  <li>[CI] Fix mesheryctl e2e tests - version incompatibilities @PragalvaXFREZ (#16973)</li>
  <li>chore: remove codecov integration @jeetburman (#16914)</li>
  <li>Fix ESLint errors in e2e test files @[copilot-swe-agent[bot]](https://github.com/apps/copilot-swe-agent) (#16947)</li>
  <li>fix broken tests @aabidsofi19 (#16936)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-documentation">📖 Documentation</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Add attendance for week of 01-15-2026 @R1sh0bh-1 (#16987)</li>
  <li>Add Debashish’s introduction to meeting notes @Debashich (#16986)</li>
  <li>Create Suhani’s introduction for newcommers attendance @Suhani95 (#16985)</li>
  <li>Add Ayush Bhandari’s attendance details @Ayush4958 (#16982)</li>
  <li>Add introduction for Om Saraykar @omsaraykar (#16984)</li>
  <li>Docs/jdoe/meeting notes jan 08 @Joiejoie1 (#16983)</li>
  <li>Add Karthik Balasubramanian @kaizakin (#16981)</li>
  <li>Add attendance record for Raunak @CodexRaunak (#16980)</li>
  <li>Add Kavitha Karunakaran’s introduction and bio @matrixkavi (#16979)</li>
  <li>[DOCS/Tutorial] Add kubernetes Services Labs @Siddhi-sahu (#16659)</li>
  <li>DOCS: Fix minor link in Meshery CLI Style Guide @Siddhi-sahu (#16976)</li>
  <li>Use column names instead of indexes for fields in permissions table @Siddhi-sahu (#15789)</li>
  <li>Fix: Update the FullscreenLoader to be consistent between prereact and postreact renders @aabidsofi19 (#16957)</li>
  <li>Add attendance week of 15th Jan 2026 @CodexRaunak (#16959)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Ayush4958, @CodexRaunak, @Copilot, @Debashich, @Joiejoie1, @PragalvaXFREZ, @R1sh0bh-1, @Rajesh-Nagarajan-11, @Siddhi-sahu, @Suhani95, @aabidsofi19, @alexquincy, @fitzergerald, @jeetburman, @kaizakin, @l5io, @leecalcote, @lekaf974, @marblom007, @matrixkavi, @meshery-ci, @omsaraykar, @ritzorama, @sangramrath, @shri771, @yi-nuo426, [copilot-swe-agent[bot]](https://github.com/apps/copilot-swe-agent), [dependabot[bot]](https://github.com/apps/dependabot) and vishalvivekm</p>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1>Meshery v0.8.199</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.8.199">Released</a> on January 17, 2026</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Revert to react 17 and skip broken tests  @aabidsofi19 (#17003)</li>
  <li>[UI] Fix fallback image paths causing 404s in Dashboard @[copilot-swe-agent[bot]](https://github.com/apps/copilot-swe-agent) (#16995)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Revert to react 17 and skip broken tests  @aabidsofi19 (#17003)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-documentation">📖 Documentation</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[DOCS] Replace absolute URLs in tutorials @Siddhi-sahu (#17001)</li>
</ul>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

           <h1>Meshery v0.8.2</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.8.2">Released</a> on December 30, 2024</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>Update Go toolchain to version 1.23.4 @devhindo (#13062)</li>
  <li>Update meshkit to v0.8.0 @devhindo (#13061)</li>
  <li>Eval documentation @aabidsofi19 (#13051)</li>
  <li>remove design configuration prettification logic @aabidsofi19 (#13049)</li>
  <li>bump meshkit @aabidsofi19 (#13048)</li>
  <li>add support for filtering by labels @aabidsofi19 (#13012)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="️-meshery-cli">⌨️ Meshery CLI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>fix(mesheryctl): Error code workflow is failing @lekaf974 (#13037)</li>
  <li>Remove the word \successfully\ @weilirs (#12932)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[UI] Environments page and related components MUI v5 migration #12913 @SAHU-01 (#13060)</li>
  <li>Revert 	est: fix some connection and performance test\ @Yashsharma1911 (#13057)</li>
  <li>Remove the word \successfully\ @weilirs (#12932)</li>
  <li>add user profile link for info modal avatar @amitamrutiya (#13035)</li>
  <li>fix the font for array formatter for designer details panel @amitamrutiya (#13032)</li>
  <li>fix meshsync connections table ( update to latest apis) @aabidsofi19 (#13031)</li>
  <li>Hide suggestion on escape and add control for manually hiding them @aabidsofi19 (#13017)</li>
  <li>Create environment modal for show in the deploy design modal @amitamrutiya (#13009)</li>
  <li>Add support for connection modal in the context switcher @amitamrutiya (#13004)</li>
  <li>Refactor DataFormatter components to remove unused props and improve … @amitamrutiya (#13013)</li>
  <li>fix placeholder in typingfilter @aabidsofi19 (#13011)</li>
  <li>proper error handling of chips for pinging metrics connections @sudhanshutech (#13010)</li>
  <li>Enhance Cluster Summary Endpoint to return all labels scoped down by the applied filters  @aabidsofi19 (#13006)</li>
  <li>enhance DataFormatter to support conditional layout and context usage @amitamrutiya (#13003)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Go Upgrade @weilirs (#12847)</li>
  <li>Update GitHub Actions to use download-artifact@v4 @devhindo (#12891)</li>
  <li>Update cncf-playground-deploy-meshery.yaml @sangramrath (#12943)</li>
  <li>[CI] deprecated link in integrations-updater.yml #13029 @Tushar240503 (#13036)</li>
  <li>refactor(mesheryctl): rename <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">pattern</code> commands to <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">design</code> due to deprecation @devhindo (#12890)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-documentation">📖 Documentation</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Update terminology from <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">pattern</code> to <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">design</code> in configuration management guides @devhindo (#13028)</li>
  <li>Create Venkata_Sai.md @Venkata-Sai-Vishwanath-robo (#13030)</li>
  <li>marking my attendance for the week of 12-23-2024 @RMB1803 (#13019)</li>
  <li>marking my attendance for Dec 26 2024 @abhisheksatpathy (#13020)</li>
  <li>Kartikeya Pandey- Attendance @eth-developer03 (#13021)</li>
  <li>marking my attendance for the week of 12-23-2024 @vishalvivekm (#13018)</li>
  <li>Create rohanc @rohan-choudharyy (#13022)</li>
  <li>My new commers meeting attendance @SupriyaKuncha (#13023)</li>
  <li>refactor(mesheryctl): rename <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">pattern</code> commands to <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">design</code> due to deprecation @devhindo (#12890)</li>
  <li>week-of-12-23-2024 @vishalvivekm (#13015)</li>
  <li>All Remaining typo fixes merged into one PR @lhajouji (#13000)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Jougan-0, @RMB1803, @SAHU-01, @SupriyaKuncha, @Tushar240503, @Venkata-Sai-Vishwanath-robo, @Yashsharma1911, @aabidsofi19, @abhisheksatpathy, @alphaX86, @amitamrutiya, @devhindo, @eth-developer03, @leecalcote, @lekaf974, @lhajouji, @ritzorama, @rohan-choudharyy, @sangramrath, @sudhanshutech, @vishalvivekm, @weilirs and @winkletinkle</p>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1>Meshery v0.8.20</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.8.20">Released</a> on January 22, 2025</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>[Server] fix deprecated Docker NetworkListOptions type in adapters_tracker.go @Tharanishwaran (#13323)</li>
  <li>[Server] Fix SA1019 Lint Error by Removing Deprecated KubeProxyVersion @Tharanishwaran (#13324)</li>
  <li>[Server] Chore: Upgrade MeshKit v0.8.5 @leecalcote (#13325)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="️-meshery-cli">⌨️ Meshery CLI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>fix: golanci-lint failed @lekaf974 (#13327)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] add layout and item-type frontmatter to models  @vishalvivekm (#13319)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] update models output path @vishalvivekm (#13318)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

           <h1>Meshery v0.8.200</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.8.200">Released</a> on January 20, 2026</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>[UI] Enable React strict mode in Next.js config @[copilot-swe-agent[bot]](https://github.com/apps/copilot-swe-agent) (#17028)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="️-meshery-cli">⌨️ Meshery CLI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>UI: Migrate to TS @hortison (#17020)</li>
  <li>Replace legacy countdown clock with React 18–compatible timer in performance UI @[copilot-swe-agent[bot]](https://github.com/apps/copilot-swe-agent) (#17024)</li>
  <li>fix: resolve model init schema paths and test failures @shri771 (#17035)</li>
  <li>[UI] Directory cleanup @leecalcote (#17015)</li>
  <li>[CI] Fix duplicate setup execution in mesheryctl E2E BATS tests @PragalvaXFREZ (#17000)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[UI] Nextjs script warning addressed. Interactive strategy used on script load. @marblom007 (#17044)</li>
  <li>UI: Migrate to TS @hortison (#17020)</li>
  <li>Replace legacy countdown clock with React 18–compatible timer in performance UI @[copilot-swe-agent[bot]](https://github.com/apps/copilot-swe-agent) (#17024)</li>
  <li>Upgrade UI CodeMirror integration to @uiw/react-codemirror (React 18 compatible) @[copilot-swe-agent[bot]](https://github.com/apps/copilot-swe-agent) (#17027)</li>
  <li>[WIP] Upgrade project to React 18 and address theme issues @[copilot-swe-agent[bot]](https://github.com/apps/copilot-swe-agent) (#17025)</li>
  <li>disable broken tests @aabidsofi19 (#17037)</li>
  <li>update eslint ignore @aabidsofi19 (#17036)</li>
  <li>Replace react-lazyload with React.lazy in Grafana charts @[copilot-swe-agent[bot]](https://github.com/apps/copilot-swe-agent) (#17026)</li>
  <li>Normalize meshmodel icon paths and cache failed image lookups @[copilot-swe-agent[bot]](https://github.com/apps/copilot-swe-agent) (#16997)</li>
  <li>Replace unmaintained react-json-view with @microlink/react-json-view @[copilot-swe-agent[bot]](https://github.com/apps/copilot-swe-agent) (#17022)</li>
  <li>ci: eslint conifg fix @marblom007 (#17018)</li>
  <li>UI: MesheryPatterns: React 18 compatibility @marblom007 (#17017)</li>
  <li>[UI] Directory cleanup @leecalcote (#17015)</li>
  <li>skip broken tests @aabidsofi19 (#17004)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>fix(CI): update workflow to publish multiple artifacts for each tested k8s versions @kaizakin (#16883)</li>
  <li>UI: Migrate to TS @hortison (#17020)</li>
  <li>disable broken tests @aabidsofi19 (#17037)</li>
  <li>[CI] Fix duplicate setup execution in mesheryctl E2E BATS tests @PragalvaXFREZ (#17000)</li>
  <li>skip broken tests @aabidsofi19 (#17004)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-documentation">📖 Documentation</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[DOCS] Remove duplicate logic in permissions.html @Siddhi-sahu (#17002)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Copilot, @PragalvaXFREZ, @Siddhi-sahu, @aabidsofi19, @fitzergerald, @hortison, @kaizakin, @l5io, @leecalcote, @lekaf974, @marblom007, @ritzorama, @saurabhraghuvanshii, @shri771, [copilot-swe-agent[bot]](https://github.com/apps/copilot-swe-agent) and vishalvivekm</p>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1>Meshery v0.8.201</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.8.201">Released</a> on January 29, 2026</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>chore(deps): bump lodash from 4.17.21 to 4.17.23 in /install/docker-extension/ui @[dependabot[bot]](https://github.com/apps/dependabot) (#17083)</li>
  <li>rename provider @aabidsofi19 (#14922)</li>
  <li>[Docker Extension] Reconcile UI package compatibility @leecalcote (#17050)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="️-meshery-cli">⌨️ Meshery CLI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[mesheryctl]: Improved error output readability for mesheryctl connection delete command @DharunMR (#17152)</li>
  <li>feat(mesheryctl): add connection list by kind and/or status support @lekaf974 (#17147)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] refactor: consolidate –output-format handling in perf command @shri771 (#17105)</li>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

</ul>

<ul>

</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>

</ul>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

           <h1>Meshery v0.8.203</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.8.203">Released</a> on February 08, 2026</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>Initial migration of docs.meshery.io from Jekyll to Hugo @CodexRaunak (#17071)</li>
  <li>Bump jsonpath from 1.1.1 to 1.2.0 in /install/docker-extension/ui @[dependabot[bot]](https://github.com/apps/dependabot) (#17287)</li>
  <li>fix: reduce retry log spam when capability fetch fails @guan404ming (#17212)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="️-meshery-cli">⌨️ Meshery CLI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Fix unsafe os.Stat handling during mesheryctl config initialization @SuryanshGarg04 (#17146)</li>
  <li>refactor: Consolidate –output-format handling in filter command  @shri771 (#17259)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] mesheryctl design onboard e2e @lekaf974 (#17283)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl]: Added E2E tests for workspace command @DharunMR (#17193)</li>
  <li>Fix duplicate error code: change mesheryctl ErrConnectionNotFoundCode from \mesheryctl-1196\ to \mesheryctl-1197\ @PragalvaXFREZ (#17268)</li>
  <li>mesheryctl/tests: change expected auth.json provider from Meshery to … @pranjalkole (#14985)</li>
  <li>template json for missing component and relationship @Jougan-0 (#13872)</li>
  <li>Changed output status for system context @DharunMR (#17187)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl]  consolidate –output-format handling in relationships command @shri771 (#17233)</li>
  <li>fix(mesheryctl/tests): Update BATS test expectations for system-check, and perf commands @PragalvaXFREZ (#17141)</li>
  <li>refactor(mesehryctl): update organization handling to use schema models @lekaf974 (#17162)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1>Meshery v0.8.204</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.8.204">Released</a> on February 08, 2026</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>Fix typos in rego policy files @guan404ming (#17346)</li>
  <li>Add make policy-lint target for Rego files @guan404ming (#17343)</li>
  <li>Remove unused variable in extract_components rego rule @guan404ming (#17344)</li>
  <li>refactor(policies): remove unused MAX_ALIASES constant @guan404ming (#17333)</li>
  <li>Update npm install command to use legacy-peer-deps @leecalcote (#17341)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="️-meshery-cli">⌨️ Meshery CLI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>fix(mesheryctl): update design list tests to fix failing test and update test name @lekaf974 (#17334)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>fix(ci): skip Rego auto-commit for fork PRs @guan404ming (#17332)</li>
  <li>[GitHub Issue Template] Chore: Update documentation.md @leecalcote (#17352)</li>
  <li>fix(mesheryctl): update design list tests to fix failing test and update test name @lekaf974 (#17334)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-documentation">📖 Documentation</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[Server] Fix None provider blank login by routing through /user/login @leecalcote (#17342)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@guan404ming, @hortison, @leecalcote and @lekaf974</p>

 

   <br/>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {
  var url = "https://api.github.com/search/repositories?q=meshery/meshery";
  fetch(url, {

  }).then(function(e) {

  }).then(function(r) {
     console.log(r.items[0])

     forks = r.items[0]['forks_count']
     $('#stars').text(stars + " Stars")
     $('#forks').text(forks + " Forks")
  });

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1>Meshery v0.8.21</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.8.21">Released</a> on January 24, 2025</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>Optimize and enhance matchlabel policy and general evaluation  @aabidsofi19 (#13341)</li>
  <li>Enhancement - custom docker image to be used in tutorials @sangramrath (#13342)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="️-meshery-cli">⌨️ Meshery CLI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[mesheryctl] fix: remove arguments check that break functionality @lekaf974 (#13338)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] Fix unreachable code and unused variable warnings in system/start.go @Tharanishwaran (#13336)</li>
  <li>fix(meshreyctl): design view tests fail @lekaf974 (#13043)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] Improve <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl registry generate</code> command by applying argument check @riyaa14 (#13255)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Fix theme toggle failure on first click in preferences @Tharanishwaran (#13124)</li>
  <li>Bump prettier from 3.0.3 to 3.4.2 in /ui @dependabot (#13097)</li>
  <li>UI: use PromptComponent from sistent  @amitamrutiya (#13343)</li>
  <li>[Chore]: Bump Sistent v0.14.145 @l5io (#13345)</li>
  <li>[Chore]: Bump Sistent v0.14.144 @l5io (#13331)</li>
  <li>fix: remoteprovider tab crash issue @amitamrutiya (#13330)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-bug-fixes">🐛 Bug Fixes</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[mesheryctl] fix: remove arguments check that break functionality @lekaf974 (#13338)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Bump prettier from 3.0.3 to 3.4.2 in /ui @dependabot (#13097)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-documentation">📖 Documentation</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Fixed unwanted top padding on headings @PR4NJ41 (#13312)</li>
  <li>marking my attendance for the week-of-01-20-2025 @vishalvivekm (#13340)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@PR4NJ41, @Tharanishwaran, @aabidsofi19, @amitamrutiya, @dependabot, @l5io, @leecalcote, @lekaf974, @riyaa14, @sangramrath, @sudhanshutech, @vishalvivekm, MUzairS15, Tharanishwaran and l5io</p>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1>Meshery v0.8.24</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.8.24">Released</a> on January 27, 2025</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>fix alias relationships @aabidsofi19 (#13369)</li>
  <li>leecalcote/go/deps @leecalcote (#13362)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-features">🚀 Features</h2>

<ul>
  <li>chore: Enhance registry update error displayed to user @lekaf974 (#13359)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="️-meshery-cli">⌨️ Meshery CLI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>chore: Enhance registry update error displayed to user @lekaf974 (#13359)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Migrate globle styling to muiv5 that used by mulitple component @amitamrutiya (#13368)</li>
  <li>[Chore]: Bump Sistent v0.14.147 @l5io (#13370)</li>
  <li>Fix some old regression issue of muiv4 @amitamrutiya (#13367)</li>
  <li>Migrate some small component and pages from muiv4 to muiv5 @amitamrutiya (#13366)</li>
  <li>remove mui v4 library and replace it with the mui v5 @amitamrutiya (#13354)</li>
  <li>[Chore]: Bump Sistent v0.14.146 @l5io (#13363)</li>
  <li>Added Data Test IDs in components for Playwright E2E Tests Verifications @THEBOSS0369 (#13211)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[CI] Chore: Delay Playground Deployment @leecalcote (#13373)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Jougan-0, @THEBOSS0369, @aabidsofi19, @amitamrutiya, @l5io, @leecalcote, @lekaf974, @marblom007, @sudhanshutech, @vishalvivekm and MUzairS15</p>

 

   <br/>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

           <h1>Meshery v0.8.26</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.8.26">Released</a> on February 03, 2025</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<h2 id="️-meshery-cli">⌨️ Meshery CLI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[mesheryctl relationship] refactoring tests not stored properly @lekaf974 (#13393)</li>
  <li>Add doc functionality to print subcommands list @alphaX86 (#12953)</li>
  <li>[CLI UX]: mesheryctl registry generate invalid JWT token response @leecalcote (#13358)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[Chore]: Bump Sistent v0.14.149 @l5io (#13449)</li>
  <li>Refactor Import and Autodetect filetype @aabidsofi19 (#13445)</li>
  <li>fix: use correct linear progress component in the grafana chart @amitamrutiya (#13448)</li>
  <li>fix: broken typing filter theme in notification center @amitamrutiya (#13447)</li>
  <li>fix: build warning due to import issue @amitamrutiya (#13431)</li>
  <li>Add support for workspace data table, teams, views and recent activity @amitamrutiya (#13423)</li>
  <li>[Chore]: Bump Sistent v0.14.148 @l5io (#13430)</li>
  <li>Adding a connection ID on the connections page @yash37158 (#13391)</li>
  <li>fix: some small ui theme regression issue @amitamrutiya (#13425)</li>
  <li>Fix: Add Flexbox Styling to TextField in Meshery Adapter Selection @Vidit-Kushwaha (#13408)</li>
  <li>fix some regressions styles and use sistent theming @sudhanshutech (#13401)</li>
  <li>fix: some regression ui light mode theme issue @amitamrutiya (#13407)</li>
  <li>Fix registry search @Yashsharma1911 (#13402)</li>
  <li>Reapply \Migrate some small component to muiv5 and remove the unused …  @amitamrutiya (#13400)</li>
  <li>Revert \Migrate some small component to muiv5 and remove the unused styles\ @amitamrutiya (#13399)</li>
  <li>Migrate some small component to muiv5 and remove the unused styles @amitamrutiya (#13394)</li>
  <li>Performance(4/4)- migrate complete performance section to sistent @sudhanshutech (#13397)</li>
  <li>Performance(3/4)- migrate performance profile and calendar section to sistent @sudhanshutech (#13395)</li>
  <li>TroubleshootModal migration to Mui5 @FaheemOnHub (#13396)</li>
  <li>Update font family name for Qanelas Soft SemiBold @leecalcote (#13388)</li>
  <li>remove old page metadata from the next config file @amitamrutiya (#13386)</li>
  <li>Remove or Migrate Unused Code to Archive Directory @amitamrutiya (#13376)</li>
  <li>remove connection wizard dead code and it’s related componen @amitamrutiya (#13385)</li>
  <li>remove smi performance page and it’s related component @amitamrutiya (#13384)</li>
  <li>Migrate registry page to muiv4 to sistent/muiv5 @amitamrutiya (#13383)</li>
  <li>[UI] Fix: Remove unwanted dot from select menu carets in Settings. @augustmood (#13148)</li>
  <li>Performance(2/4)-migrate performance result section to sistent @sudhanshutech (#13382)</li>
  <li>Performance(1/4)- migrate performance card section to sistent @sudhanshutech (#13381)</li>
  <li>Migrate Notification components to MUI v5 and align with Sistent design system @FaheemOnHub (#13360)</li>
  <li>migrate dashboard and header component to muiv5/sistent  @amitamrutiya (#13380)</li>
  <li>Migrate navigator sidebar component from muiv4 to muiv5 @amitamrutiya (#13379)</li>
</ul>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

           <h1>Meshery v0.8.27</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.8.27">Released</a> on February 07, 2025</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>refactor: removed the kube status error formatter (handled in meshkit now) @souvikinator (#13508)</li>
  <li>Update README.md @vishalvivekm (#13505)</li>
  <li>Update README.md: Youtube @fitzergerald (#13489)</li>
  <li>Add OD10 to adopters @sangramrath (#13478)</li>
  <li>upgrade meshkit to v0.8.12 @vishalvivekm (#13462)</li>
  <li>add support for kustomize @aabidsofi19 (#13460)</li>
  <li>chore:  golang upgrade @miacycle (#13457)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="️-meshery-cli">⌨️ Meshery CLI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>ci/chore/more docker repos @miacycle (#13506)</li>
  <li>Update meshery-linkerd references to use the new repository path @miacycle (#13502)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] nit: improve error logging for <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">registry generate</code> using csv files from local directory @riyaa14 (#13464)</li>
  <li>update environment doc links @aabidsofi19 (#13474)</li>
  <li>Update vendor links @aabidsofi19 (#13475)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Cleanup pattern post handler @aabidsofi19 (#13503)</li>
  <li>update discussion forum links @aabidsofi19 (#13500)</li>
  <li>Fix Placeholder Overlap in TextField When Selecting Available Adapter on First Render @PR4NJ41 (#13468)</li>
  <li>Update vendor links @aabidsofi19 (#13475)</li>
  <li>Fix: Corrected casing of ‘visibility’ to maintain consistency @PR4NJ41 (#13471)</li>
  <li>replace discuss link and rm Meshery yt links @vishalvivekm (#13459)</li>
  <li>fix: onclick behaviour for the  menu @amitamrutiya (#13458)</li>
  <li>Migrating events endpoint to system endpoints @souvikinator (#13446)</li>
  <li>[Chore]: Bump Sistent v0.14.150 @l5io (#13452)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Update links @vishalvivekm (#13507)</li>
  <li>update discussion forum links @aabidsofi19 (#13500)</li>
  <li>Bump github.com/spf13/pflag from 1.0.5 to 1.0.6 @dependabot (#13440)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-documentation">📖 Documentation</h2>

<ul>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>
